title: Ceviche de Camaron Shrimp Lime

seo.title: Easy Shrimp Ceviche Recipe: Fresh & Zesty Mexican Delight
seo.metaDescription: Learn how to make authentic Mexican Shrimp Ceviche de Camaron with fresh lime and vibrant flavors. This easy recipe is perfect for a light, refreshing meal!

seo.imageAlt: A vibrant bowl of authentic Mexican shrimp ceviche (Ceviche de Camaron) with fresh lime, cilantro, and red onion, ready to serve.
seo.imageCaption: Dive into the fresh flavors of Mexico with this easy and authentic shrimp ceviche recipe, perfect for any occasion!

description: Ceviche de Camaron is a vibrant and refreshing Mexican seafood dish, perfect for a sunny day. Fresh shrimp are marinated in tangy lime juice, which gently cooks them to perfection, infusing them with bright citrus notes. This zesty delight is then mixed with crisp vegetables like cucumber, tomato, red onion, and fresh cilantro, creating an explosion of authentic Mexican flavors that awaken the palate.

ingredients.notes: raw, peeled, deveined, tail off, chopped into 1/2-inch pieces
finely minced, seeds removed for less heat, optional

instructions.title: Prepare the Shrimp
instructions.text: Rinse the raw, peeled, and deveined shrimp under cold water. Pat them dry with paper towels. Chop the shrimp into small, bite-sized pieces, about 1/2 inch. Place the chopped shrimp in a non-reactive bowl.

instructions.title: Marinate the Shrimp
instructions.text: Pour the freshly squeezed lime juice over the chopped shrimp, ensuring all pieces are fully submerged. Stir gently. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 20-30 minutes, or until the shrimp turn opaque and pink, indicating they are gently cooked by the acidity.

instructions.title: Prepare the Vegetables
instructions.text: While the shrimp marinates, finely dice the red onion, cucumber, and tomatoes. Chop the fresh cilantro. If using, finely mince the jalapeño pepper, removing seeds for less heat.

instructions.title: Combine Ingredients
instructions.text: Once the shrimp is opaque, drain about half of the excess lime juice from the bowl, leaving enough to keep the mixture moist. Add the diced red onion, cucumber, tomatoes, cilantro, and minced jalapeño (if using) to the shrimp. Stir gently to combine all ingredients.

instructions.title: Season and Chill
instructions.text: Season the ceviche generously with salt and black pepper to taste. Taste and adjust seasonings as needed. Cover the bowl again and refrigerate for another 15-20 minutes to allow the flavors to meld beautifully.

instructions.title: Serve Fresh
instructions.text: Just before serving, gently fold in the diced avocado. Serve the fresh Ceviche de Camaron immediately with crispy tostadas or tortilla chips. Enjoy this vibrant and zesty Mexican delight!

tips: For the best flavor, always use freshly squeezed lime juice, not bottled. The acidity is key to gently cooking the shrimp and brightening all the flavors.
If you prefer a milder flavor, remove the seeds and veins from the jalapeño or serrano pepper. For a spicier kick, leave them in or add an extra pepper.

Serve your ceviche immediately after chilling for the freshest taste. Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 day; the shrimp will continue to absorb the lime flavor.
